entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A pivotal 4077 AR conflict between Greensleeves' wizard-hunters and rival wizards over the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the wizard-hunters and sacrificed her spark to revive Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Wizard who fireballs Gull and is killed by Greensleeves.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: Opposing wizard who goes mad after losing his magic.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: Opposing wizard who submits to Greensleeves.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Reaches Greensleeves and reveals her brothers survived.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: Takes Greensleeves underwater to the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: Artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam that can strip wizards of magic or grant it to anyone.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Island with the ruined College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Famed college devastated in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Long-extinct sages who created the Stone Brain.

events.summary: Greensleeves leads an expedition to Lat-Nam, fights the guardians, then befriends them and begins excavating.
events.quote: she managed to befriend the guardians and began excavating the ruins

events.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the College, where she learns the Stone Brain's true nature.
events.quote: Greensleeves was then taken underwater by the Lord of Atlantis

events.summary: Towser and Karli lead a surprise attack on her camp; Haakon fireballs Gull.
events.quote: Haakon unleashed a fireball at Gull, seemingly killing him

events.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon and traps the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert.
events.quote: killing Haakon and trapping the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert

events.summary: Greensleeves ascends to a godlike state until Kwam reveals her brothers survived.
events.quote: This revelation snapped her back to her senses.

events.summary: Greensleeves channels all her mana into the land, transforming it into a paradise and surrendering her planeswalker powers.
events.quote: she surrendered her planeswalker powers, returning to a mortal existence

events.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains as the remaining wizards submit.
events.quote: She was declared the High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

relations.quote: Accompanied by her brother Gull and their forces
killing Haakon and trapping the remaining enemy wizards in the poisoned desert
a powerful artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam
